errors.name: ClientNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a client is referenced by an invoice or payment but does not exist in the system.

errors.name: InvoiceNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an invoice is referenced by a payment but does not exist in the system.

errors.name: PaymentNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a payment is referenced but the corresponding invoice does not exist in the system.
